text: And regarding the situation with Hadera branch, if you did send in the online application will all the center of life documents at least three months in advance, you can contact PIBA's complaint department (tz@piba.gov.il) with the full details regarding your case and fact that you have been granted a renewal appointment after the visa expiry, despite submitting the renewal request in time -  in violation of clause 9ז of procedure 5.2.0008 (see here: https://www.gov.il/BlobFolder/policy/status_foreigner_married_to_israeli_procedure/he/5.2.0008.pdf)
